$comment: Vendored, not owned here. The epistemic_type value set is defined ONCE, on EvidenceBook's record header (its `epistemic_type` field, as of 2026-09-20). This file is a literal, case-folded transcription of that closed set -- created here because no machine-readable copy existed yet for capsule-engine's EPISTEMIC_TYPE_VALUES parity test to read; the parity test reads this vendored JSON, never a second hand-typed enum. A change to the owning set is a drift that must be re-vendored here, not silently re-derived.
